summary: Onboarding roadmap: heading and CTA stay pinned on the left while 3-6 steps scroll on the right; a progress line fills and each checkpoint lights up as it passes. Optional photo per step (use one on every step or none): the pinned column then shows a rounded frame under the heading that cross-fades to the photo of the step being read. On tablets, phones and with reduced motion each photo sits under its own step instead.
